I am a PhD candidate in Political Science at [UCLA](https://polisci.ucla.edu/). My research focuses on the political economy of development, public resource allocation, and applications of computational tools to social science. It has been supported by the [Fulbright Program](https://us.fulbrightonline.org/) and the [Southeast Asia Research Group](https://dcid.sanford.duke.edu/seareg/).

In addition to my academic research, I have held a number of roles spanning aid evaluation and practice. As a consultant for [Identification for Development](https://id4d.worldbank.org/) at the World Bank, I managed a research agenda to study the impacts of PhilSys, the Philippines' foundational national ID system. I have also supported refugee resettlement operations at the [International Rescue Committee](https://www.rescue.org/) and served as a Peace Corps Volunteer in the Philippines, where I developed remedial reading programming in [Roxas City, Western Visayas](https://maps.app.goo.gl/siLK6S5xnTTvZSXQA).

I hold an MA in Political Science from UCLA and a BA in International Relations and Plan II Honors from [UT Austin](https://www.utexas.edu/).
